posts.author: Batman
posts.content:
The night was dark, the moon barely visible behind the thick clouds.

'This city never sleeps,' thought Batman as he watched over Gotham from the top of a skyscraper.

Suddenly, a scream pierced the silence. Without hesitation, Batman dove into the shadows, his cape billowing like the wings of a bat.

He landed in the alley just as the thug raised his knife. “Not tonight,” Batman growled, stepping out of the darkness.

posts.author: Catwoman
posts.content:
“Looks like I’m not the only one prowling the night,” Catwoman purred from a nearby rooftop.

She leapt down, landing gracefully beside Batman.

“Care for some company?” she teased, her eyes glinting mischievously in the dim light.
